ModMetaData.name: Performance Fish Lister Hotfix
ModMetaData.author: Allen / OpenAI
ModMetaData.description:
EN: Runtime recovery hotfix for Performance Fish / Fishery ListerThings FishTable corruption ("Failed to find parent index"). Repairs Performance Fish Lister index/type caches only when corruption is detected, while preserving normal Performance Fish behavior otherwise.
中文：修复 Performance Fish / Fishery 在 ListerThings 中出现的 FishTable 结构损坏（“Failed to find parent index”）。仅在检测到损坏时自动恢复 Lister 索引/类型缓存，正常情况下保持 Performance Fish 原有逻辑与性能优化。
